Category: Public Infrastructure & Utilities
Priority: Medium
Suggested action: Dispatch barangay maintenance or the local electrician to inspect the streetlight; if it is barangay-maintained, replace the bulb or repair wiring; if managed by the local electric cooperative or city engineering office, report the exact pole number/location to them for replacement.

**Category:** Public Safety / Environmental Hazard  
**Priority:** High  
**Suggested action:** Dispatch barangay responders/tanods immediately to cordon off the area, check for damaged power lines or injured persons, and coordinate with the local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (BDRRMO/CDRRMO) or CENRO for rapid tree-clearing operations.

**Category:** Infrastructure / Public Safety  
**Priority:** Medium  
**Suggested action:** Conduct an ocular inspection of the reported area to map out dark spots, coordinate with the Municipal/City Engineering Office or local electric cooperative, and schedule the procurement and installation of streetlights (such as LED or solar-powered lights).

Category: Public Infrastructure / Utilities
Priority: Medium
Suggested action: Dispatch a barangay maintenance personnel to inspect the exact location and pole number, then coordinate with the Municipal/City Engineering Office or local electric utility provider to replace the bulb or repair the fixture.

Category: Infrastructure / Public Safety
Priority: Medium
Suggested action: Dispatch a barangay maintenance personnel to inspect the reported location, replace the bulb or fixture if minor, or coordinate with the local electric utility/City Engineering Office for necessary technical repairs.

**Category:** Traffic Management and Public Safety  
**Priority:** Medium  
**Suggested action:** Deploy Barangay Public Safety Officers (BPSO/Tanods) to monitor the intersection during peak hours to guide pedestrians and deter jaywalking. Coordinate with the city/municipal traffic enforcement office to conduct an anti-jaywalking campaign and install visible pedestrian safety signage or barriers if needed.

**Category:** Public Infrastructure / Public Safety (Street Lighting Maintenance)  
**Priority:** Medium  
**Suggested action:** Dispatch barangay maintenance personnel to inspect the reported location, replace defective or low-wattage bulbs with proper LED lights, and coordinate with the local electric utility or City/Municipal Engineering Office if electrical wiring or fixture replacement is required.

Category: Infrastructure / Public Works (Road Maintenance)
Priority: Medium
Suggested action: Conduct an on-site inspection, install temporary warning markers or cones to prevent accidents, and endorse the request to the Barangay Maintenance Committee or City/Municipal Engineering Office for asphalt patching or road repair.

**Category:** Public Infrastructure / Utilities  
**Priority:** Medium  
**Suggested action:** Dispatch a barangay maintenance staff or tanod to verify the exact pole location and inspect the damage, then coordinate with the City/Municipal Engineering Office or the local electric utility provider for repair or bulb replacement.

**Category:** Infrastructure / Public Safety  
**Priority:** Medium  
**Suggested action:** Conduct an ocular inspection to identify the specific dark areas, coordinate with the City/Municipal Engineering Office or local electric utility for installation or repairs, and allocate funds in the Barangay Annual Investment Plan for adequate street lighting.
